descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologia informației și servicii informatice
Role Overview 
 We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Technician to join our IT team and help ensure the quality and stability of our software products. The role involves testing new features, validating releases, identifying and documenting defects, and working closely with developers throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
 We work in a Kanban + CI/CD environment with frequent releases, so we are looking for someone organized, responsible, and comfortable taking ownership of the features assigned for testing.
 Main Responsibilities 
 • Plan, execute, and document testing activities for assigned features and change sets
 • Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and post-release testing
 • Create, maintain, and update test cases and QA documentation in the approved tools
 • Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects with clear and complete information
 • Collaborate closely with developers, product stakeholders, and release teams to clarify issues and validate fixes
 • Participate in release validation and provide QA sign-off before deployment
 • Monitor risks, identify edge cases, and help improve overall product quality
 • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives related to QA processes, tooling, and testing strategies
 • Use AI tools (such as Claude) responsibly to support test design, edge-case discovery, documentation, and analysis, while ensuring all outputs are reviewed before use
 Requirements 
 • Previous experience in Software Testing / Quality Assurance
 • Good understanding of SDLC, defect lifecycle, and release processes
 • Experience working with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, Xray, Zephyr, TestRail or similar)
 • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
 • Good communication and collaboration skills
 • Ability to manage priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment
 • Structured and proactive approach to problem solving
 Nice to have 
 • Experience working in CI/CD environments
 • API testing knowledge
 • Familiarity with AI productivity tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
 • Exposure to automation testing concepts
 • Experience contributing to QA process improvements
 What we value 
 • Ownership and accountability
 • Proactive attitude and continuous improvement mindset
 • Reliability, discipline, and attention to quality
 • Team collaboration and knowledge sharing
 • Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools and processes
